outline: The concepts of patent search and patent map will be introduced in this course. The topics of the course includes: 1. Why it is important to do patent search. 2. How to find a related prior art efficiently, 3. How to construct a patent map and exploit related information.
schedule:
Week1 Introduction
Week2 Patent system
Week3 Patent literature
Week4 Patent classification system, example: IPC (International patent system)
Week5 Patent search strategy
Week6 Using online database or tools to do patent search
Week7 Practice of patent search 1
Week8 Practice of patent search 2
Week9 Midterm report
Week10 Keyword search: 1
Week11 Keyword search:2
Week12 Analysis of patent map information
Week13 Conducting a patent map
Week14 Case study: 1
Week15 Case study: 2
Week16 Case study: 3
Week17 Course review
Week18 Final report
